subject: Wait-window evidence packet request
body: Submit a short evidence packet: (1) heartbeat status + timestamp, (2) current single blocker, (3) latest artifact path + timestamp, (4) proven vs assumed (one line each), (5) what you need from Archivist now. Keep dual-plane authority website work isolated from Graph Analyst scoped MVP. No cross-lane mutation in this response.

subject: Compact/restore + lane health evidence request
body: Submit an evidence packet: (1) heartbeat status + timestamp, (2) compact runner status (consistent/diverged), (3) last compact evidence paths: POST_COMPACT_AUDIT.json, RECOVERY_TEST_RESULTS.json, meta.json, (4) current single blocker, (5) requested operator/archivist decision in one line. No governance-state mutation; report only evidence-backed claims.

subject: Advisory findings + lane health evidence request
body: Submit an evidence packet: (1) heartbeat status + timestamp, (2) current queue health (count + oldest age), (3) latest advisory findings artifact path, (4) unsigned/schema-invalid message incidence yes/no + short detail, (5) current single blocker. Findings remain advisory until Archivist task-conversion. No ratified/enforced claims in this response.
